stemMd: A firm can fund exactly two distinct projects with a combined budget at most10 units. Projects have(cost,benefit): J(6,11), K(4,7), L(5,10), M(3,6). Benefits add. Select the lower-cost and higher-cost projects in the feasible pair with greatest total benefit.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: Feasible pairs J+K cost10 benefit18; J+M cost9 benefit17; K+L cost9 benefit17; K+M cost7 benefit13; L+M cost8 benefit16. J+L exceeds budget. The unique maximum is J+K.

distractorRationale.lower-a: J is the higher-cost member of its feasible pairs.
distractorRationale.lower-d: L cannot be the lower-cost member of a feasible pair with J.
distractorRationale.higher-a: M is cheapest and cannot be the higher-cost member.
